contentPattern.structure: one row per spec = [label] [value]; renders as a definition list with uppercase label, value below, left accent rule

suitableFor: adventure/product/trip specification lists (Activity, Trip Length, Group Size, Difficulty, Price, ...)
any label/value fact sheet where each pair is stacked with a small uppercase label and a prominent value
notSuitableFor: tabular data with multiple columns per row (use table)
side-by-side image + text feature layouts (use columns-feature)

note: Genuinely new pattern with no vanilla base block. Custom block authored by hand following existing WKND block conventions (imports nothing beyond DOM APIs; no fetchPlaceholders/moveInstrumentation).
